questions.subject: Physics
questions.topic: Helical Motion with Pitch & Oblique Angle
questions.category: Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism :: Multi-Concept Physical Modeling (Type 2)
questions.question: A charged particle of mass $m$ and charge $q$ enters a uniform magnetic field $B$ at an angle $\theta = 60^\circ$ to the field with speed $v = 20\text{ m/s}$ in [Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism]. What is the pitch of the resulting helical path?
questions.solution: Pitch $p = v_\parallel T = (v \cos 60^\circ) \left(\frac{2\pi m}{q B}\right) = \left(v \times \frac{1}{2}\right)\left(\frac{2\pi m}{q B}\right) = \frac{\pi m v}{q B} = \frac{\pi m (20)}{q B}$.
questions.explanation: Analyze the physical model and equations in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism.
tags: Helical Motion with Pitch & Oblique Angle

questions.subject: Physics
questions.topic: Helical Motion with Pitch & Oblique Angle
questions.category: Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism :: Numerical Derivation
questions.question: One mole of ideal gas undergoes a polytropic expansion $P V^2 = C$ in [Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism] from volume $V_0 = 1\text{ m}^3$ at pressure $P_0 = 10^5\text{ Pa}$ to $V_1 = 2\text{ m}^3$. Calculate the magnitude of work done by the gas in $\text{kJ}$ rounded to nearest integer.
questions.solution: Work done in polytropic process with $n=2$: $W = \frac{P_0 V_0 - P_1 V_1}{n - 1} = P_0 V_0 \left(1 - \frac{V_0}{V_1}\right) = 10^5 \times 1 \times (1 - 0.5) = 5 \times 10^4\text{ J} = 50\text{ kJ}$.
questions.explanation: Calculate using quantitative physical laws in Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism.
tags: Helical Motion with Pitch & Oblique Angle
